description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao in the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations, search filtering, and counting methods related to employee immigration records within the Pim module.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDaoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao, performing tests for save, update, retrieve, delete, and search functionalities related to employee immigration records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and sets up test data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee immigration record and verifies fields.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee immigration record.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee immigration record.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of employee immigration records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Tests searching for records with filters.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching with a limit to result count.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Tests obtaining the count of search results.
